zotero.abstractNote: The retina provides a unique opportunity to develop a complete and precise model of a computational module in the central nervous system. We argue that an open, collaborative modelling ecosystem is now essential to move the field from isolated studies toward a unified, quantitative understanding of retinal function. To this end, we introduce openretina, a collaborative project and software ecosystem designed to facilitate the development, sharing, and benchmarking of retinal models across diverse datasets and species. openretina provides a standardized framework for data handling, model training, and in silico experiments, enabling researchers to build upon existing work and compare models on a common ground. By fostering a community-driven approach, we aim to accelerate progress in retinal neuroscience and provide a blueprint for collaborative modelling in other areas of systems neuroscience.
